evidence_spans: Metallic impurities such as Ni 2+ , Fe 2+ , and Co 2+ enhance the corrosion resistance of AlCoCrFeNi 2.1 via enrichment of impurity ions such as Ni, Co, and Fe (to lesser extent) in the corrosion layer
